label: Silk learns a draft
notes: GPU 0 motion experiment. Frames land in outputs/atlas/ so they never appear on the fashion gallery. One fixed scene; no people; no Arcane.
prompt: A naturally progressing fine-art motion study on a luminous mostly white ground: one long sheet of undyed raw silk pinned to a wooden drying line, a slow cross-breeze taking a travelling fold from left to right, the cloth answering then settling, exact fabric grain, quiet paper tooth, restrained mineral pigment, no people, no faces, no text, no border, no product shot, no photorealism
subject: silk on a drying line learning a draft of wind
